name: nghiem
description: QA that can fail: expected results are fixed before the code is read, every verdict points to evidence, and failures are classified and reported instead of patched.

test_hosts.title: Test hosts
test_hosts.description: Comma-separated host names that QA may send write requests (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) to, for example staging.example.com,localhost. Every other host is read-only during a QA run.

report_dir.title: Run folder
report_dir.description: Folder inside the project where QA runs are written.
